# local-litertlm-3050oem-2b-int248
#
# Install into the system python3's user site:
#   python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt
# Never create a virtualenv (CLAUDE.md). Debian marks the system interpreter
# externally managed and has no python3-litert-lm package.

# Pulls litert-lm-api (the 33 MB native wheel with liblitert-lm.so) and
# litert-lm-builder. Measured with 0.19.0.
litert-lm==0.19.0

# litert-lm-builder's generated _pb2 files import google.protobuf.runtime_version
# (protobuf >= 5.26; they were generated by 6.31.1). Debian's python3-protobuf
# 3.21.12 fails at import. Measured with 7.36.2.
protobuf>=6.31.1
